title: Hearty Mediterranean Couscous Pilaf
description: A peppery and crisp Mediterranean dish featuring couscous, perfect for a hangover cure, and diabetic-friendly. This pilaf is made with brine-wet ingredients for added flavor.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large saucepan.
Add the couscous to the boiling broth, cover, and turn off the heat.
Let the couscous sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced red onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, and pepperoncini.
Combine the cooked couscous, olive mixture, and crumbly feta cheese in a large bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
